---
title: "TAOOH — primary model fitting"
subtitle: "Second-order Bayesian ordinal transition models with random intercepts"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The primary model conditions on `yprev` and `ypprev` and includes the
patient-level random intercept specified in the SAP. All 50 models are fitted
through the reviewed `markov.misc::blrm_markov()` API.
The numeric weekly time scale infers its starting profile from week 1; those
rows remain in every completed branch.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
indices <- module_exact_indices(config)
data_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "imputations")
model_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "models"))
diagnostic_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "diagnostics"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"),
  here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"), knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-taooh-models
#| include: false
for (index in indices) {
  data_path <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  diagnostic_path <- file.path(diagnostic_dir, sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!file.exists(data_path)) stop("Missing TAOOH imputation branch: ", data_path)
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("primary-taooh-fitting-%02d", index),
    input_paths = data_path,
    output_paths = c(model_path, diagnostic_path),
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(endpoint = "taooh", imputation = index, order = 2L,
                   random_intercept = "id", chains = 4L, iterations = 1000L,
                   warmup = 500L),
    worker = function() {
      data <- module_read_parquet(data_path)
      module_require_columns(data, c("id", "tx", "y", "yprev", "ypprev", "week"), "TAOOH imputation branch")
      data$y <- factor(data$y, levels = 1:5, ordered = TRUE)
      data$yprev <- factor(data$yprev, levels = 1:5, ordered = FALSE)
      data$ypprev <- factor(data$ypprev, levels = 1:5, ordered = FALSE)
      dd <- rms::datadist(data)
      old_datadist <- getOption("datadist")
      options(datadist = "dd")
      on.exit(options(datadist = old_datadist), add = TRUE)
      model_formula <- y ~ tx + rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev + ypprev +
        week %ia% yprev + week %ia% ypprev +
        ecog_fstcnt + factor(diagnosis) + rms::rcs(albumin, 3) +
        rms::rcs(c_reactive_protein, 3)
      fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "taooh", index)
      fit <- tryCatch(
        markov.misc::blrm_markov(
          formula = model_formula,
          ppo = ~week,
          cppo = function(y) y,
          data = data,
          id_var = "id",
          time_var = "week",
          random_intercept = "id",
          p_var = "yprev",
          p2_var = "ypprev",
          chains = as.integer(config$markov$chains),
          iter = as.integer(config$markov$iterations),
          warmup = as.integer(config$markov$warmup),
          seed = fit_seed,
          refresh = 0L
        ),
        error = identity
      )
      diagnostics <- if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
        fit
      } else {
        tryCatch(markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics), error = identity)
      }
      retry <- inherits(fit, "error") || inherits(diagnostics, "error") ||
        !isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)
      if (retry) {
        if (!isTRUE(config$diagnostics$retry_on_failure)) {
          stop("TAOOH primary Markov fit failed and retries are disabled for imputation ", index, ".")
        }
        fit <- markov.misc::blrm_markov(
          formula = model_formula,
          ppo = ~week,
          cppo = function(y) y,
          data = data,
          id_var = "id",
          time_var = "week",
          random_intercept = "id",
          p_var = "yprev",
          p2_var = "ypprev",
          chains = as.integer(config$markov$chains),
          iter = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations),
          warmup = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L),
          seed = as.integer(fit_seed + 500000L),
          refresh = 0L
        )
        diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics)
      }
      assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)
      module_save_rds(fit, model_path)
      module_save_parquet(as.data.frame(diagnostics$summary), diagnostic_path)
    }
  )
}
model_paths <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", indices))
if (length(model_paths) != 50L || !all(file.exists(model_paths))) {
  stop("TAOOH fitting stage did not produce all 50 model branches.")
}
```
